overall.summary: Every claim, count, rule and ablation reproduces, including over all 432 configurations; the only problem is the stated size of the veto (said to be -70 or less when it fires; the smallest firing value is -58).

findings.statement: id_suppress = -11.11*274 + 4.00 whenever 274 fires, i.e. a penalty of -70 or more (-269 with all five)
findings.check: exit id_suppress over the 345 training rows (scratch frame.py) and over all 432 configurations
findings.evidence: firing values range from -58.2 to -269.3; with the stated minimum pre-activation 5.6 the formula itself gives -11.11*5.6+4.00 = -58.2, not -70. The conclusion (forces the output to 0) still holds: no configuration with three or more first values is positive.
